name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme in Ladakh
benefit: Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in Ladakh, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The applicant should have completed a pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in Ladakh after being selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government&#39;s Religious Trust and Endowment Department.
   1. Only individuals selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government&#39;s Religious Trust and Endowment Department for the pilgrimage are eligible for the scheme&#39;s benefits.
   1. The applicant must not be an income taxpayer.
   1. Financial assistance is available to each individual only once in their lifetime.

**Note:** To avail the benefit of this scheme, pilgrims should submit all the documents detailing their actual expenses during the journey.
